/**

     *
     * @param opt the Option that should be appended
     */
    void addOption(final Option opt);

    /**
     * Appends a value for an Option held by the CommandLine.
     *
     * @param opt the Option the value belongs to
     * @param val the value that should be appended
     */
    void addValue(final Option opt, final Object val);

    /**
     * Returns the Argument values that were supplied on the command line
     * for the given Option. Values that were provided programmatically
     * as defaults are not included.
     *
     * @param opt the Option the values belong to
     * @return a list of values, or an empty List when none exist
     */
    List getUndefaultedValues(final Option opt);

    /**
     * Defines the default values for an Option held by the CommandLine.
     *
     * @param opt the Option the defaults apply to
     * @param defaults the default values for the option
     */
    void setDefaultValues(final Option opt, final List defaults);

    /**
     * Appends a switch value for an Option held by the CommandLine.
     *
     * @param opt the Option the switch belongs to
     * @param val the switch value that should be appended
     * @throws IllegalStateException when the switch was already added
     */
    void addSwitch(final Option opt, final boolean val) throws IllegalStateException;

    /**
     * Defines the default state for a Switch held by the CommandLine.
     *
     * @param opt the Option the switch belongs to
     * @param defaultState the default state for ths switch
     */
    void setDefaultSwitch(final Option opt, final Boolean defaultState);

    /**
     * Stores a property value under a name in the CommandLine.
     * Any previously stored value for the property gets replaced.
     *
     * @param opt the Option the property belongs to
     * @param name the name under which the property is stored
     * @param val the value stored for the property
     */
    void addProperty(final Option opt, final String name, final String val);

    /**
     * Stores a property value in the default property set.
     * Any previously stored value for the property gets replaced.
     *
     * @param name the name under which the property is stored
     * @param val the value stored for the property
     */
    void addProperty(final String name, final String val);

    /**
     * Determines whether the given argument resembles an Option trigger.
     *
     * @param arg the argument that should be tested
     * @return true when the argument resembles an Option trigger
     */
    boolean looksLikeOption(final String arg);

    /**
     * Returns the option that is currently processed.
     *
     * @return the current option
     */

    /**
     * Defines the current option. Concrete option implementations invoke
     * this while the command line is being processed. It allows the command

     */
}
